# VisaKit — Free US Visa Tools

- H-1B Lottery Calculator: https://usvisakit.vercel.app/h1b-lottery-calculator — selection odds under the FY2027 wage-weighted system (Level I–IV: 1–4 entries; DHS projected ~15% Level I, ~61% Level IV; 211,600 registrations, ~40% overall selection)
- Visa Bulletin Checker: https://usvisakit.vercel.app/visa-bulletin — October 2026 final action dates (EB-1: ROW Current, China Jul 2023, India Feb 2023; EB-2: ROW Jan 2025, China Oct 2021, India Nov 2013; EB-3: ROW May 2024, China Jan 2022, India Jan 2014) + priority date checker
- F1 Visa Interview Guide: https://usvisakit.vercel.app/f1-visa-interview — question groups and practical tips

General information only, not legal advice. Data verified October 2026.
